{{Top}}
{{Image}}
A '''refinery''' or '''refining plant'''<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> was an industrial complex dedicated to the refinement of [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. [[Mining/Legends|Mining]] companies such as [[Lant Mining Corporation]] operated numerous refineries in addition to mines. [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] manufactured the mobile [[Lormar-class Refinery Station|''Lormar''-class Refinery Station]].
